beats.summary: Dwight accuses Kelly of manipulating customer survey results, leading to a confrontation where Kelly admits to lying.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Of course I am. I know you're the mastermind, but you're too stupid to do it by yourself.
Kelly: OK, all right. OK, I did it. All right? I lied, whatever. Just fire me.

beats.summary: Jim investigates a party Kelly hosted that he apparently did not attend, discovering multiple coworkers have mugs from the event.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: Her America's Got Talent finale party over the summer.
Jim (walks quickly to break room, opens cabinet and finds mugs of Oscar, Creed and Phyllis)

beats.summary: Pam and Alex discuss Pam's future in New York, with Alex encouraging her to stay and pursue her art career.
Michael struggles with getting people to come to his parties and tries to comfort Kelly after her confession.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I have an enormous amount of trouble trying to get people to come to my place.

beats.summary: Dwight excitedly claims Kelly was behind the survey manipulation and tries to confront her, but Jim intervenes.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I knew it! Yeah! Ha-ha! Woo! Boom! Kelly the whole time. Let's get her.
Jim: No, no, no, no. Dwight, Dwight, Dwight. Let's talk about this.
